rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe
rules.query: group by (pipeline, run_type) (bioetl_control_plane_manifest_present or on (pipeline, run_type) bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total or on (pipeline, run_type) bioetl_manifest_ledger_integrity_ratio or on (pipeline, run_type) bioetl_workflow_pipeline_expected)

rules.name: bioetl_replay_safety_blockers_15m
rules.query: round(sum by (pipeline, run_type) (((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{status="failed"}[15m])) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * on (pipeline) group_left () (((sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{status="failed"}[15m])) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0)) + (sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[15m])) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0)) + (sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_replay_reconstructability_events_total{status="not_reconstructable"}[15m])) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0)) + (sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total[15m])) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0))))) + (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_replay_drift_events_total[15m])) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_replay_duplicate_overwrite_risk_total[15m])) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + ((max by (pipeline, run_type) (bioetl_manifest_ledger_integrity_ratio{integrity_type="inconsistent"}) > bool 0) * 2 or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)))))

rules.name: bioetl_manifest_ledger_failures_15m
rules.query: round(sum by (pipeline, run_type) (((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{status="failed"}[15m])) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * on (pipeline) group_left () (sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{status="failed"}[15m])) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0))) + ((max by (pipeline, run_type) (bioetl_manifest_ledger_integrity_ratio{integrity_type="inconsistent"}) > bool 0) * 2 or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)))))

rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_telemetry_missing_5m
rules.query: clamp_max(sum by (pipeline, run_type) (((bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe unless on (pipeline, run_type) sum by (pipeline, run_type) (count_over_time(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total[5m]))) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + ((bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe unless on (pipeline, run_type) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * on (pipeline) group_left () ((sum by (pipeline) (count_over_time(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total[5m])) > bool 0) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0)))) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + ((bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe unless on (pipeline, run_type) (count by (pipeline, run_type) (count_over_time(bioetl_replay_duplicate_overwrite_risk_total{risk_type=~"duplicate|overwrite"}[5m])) == 2)) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0)) + ((bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe unless on (pipeline, run_type) (count by (pipeline, run_type) (count_over_time(bioetl_manifest_ledger_integrity_ratio{integrity_type=~"consistent|inconsistent"}[5m])) == 2)) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * 0))), 4)

rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_checkpoint_evidence_status
rules.query: max by (pipeline, run_type) (((bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe unless on (pipeline) bioetl_checkpoint_age_seconds) * 3) or (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * on (pipeline) group_left () clamp_max((bioetl_checkpoint_age_seconds >= bool 900) + (bioetl_checkpoint_age_seconds >= bool 3600), 2)))

rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_current_status_trusted
rules.query: max by (pipeline, run_type) (label_replace(clamp_max(bioetl_replay_safety_blockers_15m, 2), "required_evidence", "replay_safety", "", "") or label_replace(bioetl_control_plane_checkpoint_evidence_status, "required_evidence", "checkpoint_freshness", "", "") or label_replace((bioetl_control_plane_telemetry_missing_5m > bool 0) * 3, "required_evidence", "telemetry_completeness", "", ""))

rules.name: bioetl_trust_replay_blocker_events_total
rules.query: sum by (pipeline, run_type) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe * on (pipeline) group_left () (sum by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{status="failed"}) or (max by (pipeline) (bioetl_control_plane_run_type_universe) * 0)))

rules.name: bioetl_trust_replay_blocker_events_total

rules.name: bioetl_trust_replay_blocker_events_total

rules.name: bioetl_trust_replay_blocker_events_total

rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_manifest_fail_severity_30m

rules.name: bioetl_control_plane_ledger_fail_severity_30m
